author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜೊತೆಯಿರಲು ಸತ್ವಗುಣ ಸುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಸಾನ
ಕತೆ ನೂರು ಯೋಚನೆಯು ಅದುವೆಗುಣರಜವು
ಹತ ಮನವು ಆಲಸ್ಯ ಹತಭಾಗ್ಯ ತಮವೆನುವ
ಮತಿನುಡಿಪ ಮೂರುಗುಣ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: With sattva, you end in happiness;
a hundred stories and thoughts, that is the quality of rajas;
a defeated mind, sloth, ill-fortune: that is called tamas;
these are the three qualities that speak through the mind, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The verse sketches the three guṇas: sattva brings contentment; rajas is the restless mind full of plans and stories; tamas is dullness, sloth and defeat. All three show themselves in how we think.
